retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a close-up, intimate portrait of a duo with high-contrast black and white photography and a prominent textured crochet garment.
excludeWhen: modern digital clean photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a grainy, high-contrast black and white photograph of a man and woman. The woman wears round glasses and a colorful, heavily textured crochet shawl wrapped around the man. The background is a neutral, aged off-white. Typography is placed in the upper corners in a classic serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: Intimate physical proximity between the two subjects
Contrast between smooth skin tones and coarse crochet texture
Symmetrical typographic placement in top corners
Warm, aged paper patina across the entire frame
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography with visible grain
Presence of a multi-colored, textured crochet or knit element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The duo occupies the central and lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face serves as the central focal point, framed by the woman's arm and shawl.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the man's face to the woman's smile, then follow the diagonal line of the crochet shawl down to the rings on her hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open space is concentrated at the top of the frame to accommodate the title text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal shadows in the photography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted earth tones (rust, olive, mustard) within the crochet pattern
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the photographic subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is a traditional italic-style flourish

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different colors for balance.
graphicDevices: Small logo/catalog number box in top left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-legibility transitional serif style of the era.
Provides the necessary stroke contrast and classic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a man with long hair and a beard and a woman with round glasses, both smiling. The woman should have her arm around the man, wearing a thick, colorful crochet shawl. The background should be a plain, aged off-white paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add serif text in the top left corner in a muted brick red and in the top right corner in a medium grey. Ensure the font is small and elegant.

verificationChecks: Is the photography high-contrast and grainy?
Is the crochet texture prominent and detailed?
Are the text elements placed strictly in the upper corners?
Does the overall image have a warm, aged paper patina?

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the crochet shawl
Warmth of the background paper tone
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows in the hair and clothing.
Verify the crochet pattern looks hand-made and thick.
Ensure the text is small and does not crowd the subjects.
Confirm the background has a subtle yellowed/aged paper effect.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast duo portrait + textured knitwear + corner-aligned serif typography + aged paper finish.
